verdict.rationale: Supabase's branching feature is documented explicitly as a way to create and test schema/config changes in isolated environments before touching production (supabase-docs-10/17/24), and the CLI/MCP integration lets AI agents query and act on Supabase projects (supabase-docs-1/27, supabase-probe-4). However, there is no direct documentation showing an agent programmatically creating/managing a branch via MCP or CLI, and community reports raise concerns about MCP being used against production data without the docs warning against it (supabase-comm-4), suggesting the agent+branch workflow isn't a turnkey, well-documented combination. Missing for 10: explicit docs/examples of an AI agent invoking branch creation via MCP/CLI, and confirmation that branch-scoped credentials prevent production access during agent testing.
